note: Levelling art, first drafts (23 Nov). The loot sheet's form: name -> box, with frames left to right. Sizes in px at 640x360. See README.md.

memory_frame.note: The Memory bar's frame: the mana bar's layout, one pixel thicker, with a Memory mote in its left cap. Draw memory_empty then memory_fill (cut to the share that is full) at fill_at.

memory_fill.note: What is carried. Cut it from the left, as the mana fill is. Its quarter marks line up with the empty bar's.

memory_empty.note: The empty bar, with quarter marks.

level_badge.note: The squad's level: write the number on the dark middle (9x7 at (3, 3)) in the HUD's amber.

memory_marker.note: Left where a player fell, holding the Memory they lost. A slow loop. No outline, as the mote. Origin on the ground under it. No shadow (it is a light).

memory_marker_take.note: Played once when the marker is collected; then fly memory_mote to the player as a chest does.

level_up.note: Played once over every player when the squad gains a level. Origin at the player's feet; draw it over the player. Frame 4 is the moment the level lands.
